symptoms: ECG: ST elevation >= 1mm in contiguous leads (V2-V3 >= 2mm men >= 40, >= 2.5mm men < 40, >= 1.5mm women), or new/presumably new LBBB (Sgarbossa criteria >= 3 points)

management_steps.details: Oxygen if SpO2 < 94% (2L/min). Aspirin 300 mg chewed STAT (if allergic: Clopidogrel 300mg PO STAT). Nitroglycerin 1 spray or SL tablet q5min (max 3 doses). Morphine 1-2mg IV aliquots.

Door to needle time <= 30 mins. Options:
1. TPA / Alteplase (Actilyse): 15mg IV bolus, then 0.75mg/kg over 30min (max 50mg), then 0.5mg/kg over 60min (max 35mg). Max total dose 100mg.
2. Streptokinase (Streptase): 1.5MU in 200ml N/S over 1hr.
3. Tenecteplase (Metalyse): Weight < 100kg 8 000 IU IV over 10s; Weight > 100kg 10 000 IU IV over 10s.

Anticoagulation: Clexane 30mg IV STAT, then 1mg/kg SC starting 15 minutes after bolus; OR Unfractionated Heparin 60IU/kg (max 4000IU) IV STAT, then 12IU/kg/hr (max 1000IU/hr). Clopidogrel 300mg PO STAT. Simvastatin 40mg PO STAT. Atenolol 50mg PO STAT (if no contraindications).

warnings: Nitroglycerin C/I: SBP < 90, HR < 50 or > 100, RV infarction, PDE5 inhibitor use within 24-48h.

Absolute Thrombolysis C/I: Prior intracranial hemorrhage, known structural cerebrovascular lesion, malignant intracranial neoplasm, ischemic stroke within 3 months (except acute within 3h), suspected aortic dissection, active bleeding/bleeding diathesis, significant closed head/facial trauma within 3 months.
